name: LEXVARON
summary: Confident modern law-firm site: tight General Sans on warm off-white, white rounded cards, near-black and safety-orange accent tiles, photo hero card with a floating team chip.

fonts.pairing: single family: General Sans 500 with -0.035 to -0.045em tracking for headings and stats, 400 for body, 12px wide-tracked caps eyebrows in pills

signature: card rows that cycle white, white, black, orange to create rhythm
orange dot inside every pill eyebrow and button
stat row ending in a solid orange tile
floating white card with overlapping avatar circles on the hero photo
imagery: dark, warm documentary photos of documents and handshakes, classical columns, corporate headshots on neutral backgrounds
layout_grid: 1176px content, 32px side padding, 110px section padding, 56px header-to-content gap, 3 and 4 column card grids
